properties.biography: Tycho began as Scott Hansen's ambient/electronic solo project while he was also active as a graphic designer under the name ISO50. Hansen released The Science of Patterns EP and the full-length Sunrise Projector in the early 2000s; Past Is Prologue (2006) expanded his profile in the IDM/ambient community. Signed to Ghostly International, Hansen released Dive in 2011, which broadened his audience with more live instrumentation and richly layered production. Touring behind Dive led Hansen to recruit Zac Brown (guitar/bass) and Rory O'Connor (drums) and reshape Tycho into a three-piece on subsequent records such as Awake and Epoch. Tycho's aesthetic pairs meticulous audio production with distinctive visual art and has been featured in TV/animation (Toonami, Adult Swim) and numerous sync placements.

Initially a studio project, Tycho expanded into a three-piece live band (with Zac Brown and Rory O'Connor) to translate the recordings into dynamic, visual-driven performances. Key releases include Sunrise Projector (2004), Past Is Prologue (2006), Dive (2011), Awake (2014), Epoch (2016) and Weather (2019); most albums have been released on Ghostly International.
properties.cultural_impact: Tycho helped popularize a warm, melodic strain of ambient and downtempo electronic music in the 2010s, bridging IDM aesthetics with post-rock and chillwave audiences. Tycho's records and live shows expanded the commercial and festival presence of instrumental electronic music and have been widely used in sync placements, licensing and modern cinematic playlists.
